title: Night Rain
summary: A sleepy walk through gentle rain to a cozy cabin: drizzle, thunder, take shelter.
script:
Listen, it's drizzling today. It's drizzling today.
To drizzle is when rain falls very slowly.

It's drizzling, gently watering the plants.

Imagine yourself walking through this drizzle.
You can see the beautiful plants being watered by this gentle rain.

Imagine you're wearing a raincoat that protects you from it.
This raincoat makes you feel warm and dry.

But now, you can hear a storm coming from far away.
Listen to that sound, that sound is thunder.

Now imagine yourself finding a cozy cabin where you can take shelter from the storm. Take shelter means to go somewhere safe to protect yourself.

You open the door to this cabin and it's so cozy.

There is a soft blanket waiting for you on the bed.
You shake the blanket out before getting into bed.

Then, you fluff your pillows and lie down on the bed.

Now you're falling asleep.
Good night.

vocabulary.definition: the sound of a storm coming from far away
to go somewhere safe to protect yourself
